name: net_prologue_mansion_hall_host_down
description: VUH-2866 downed variant of net_prologue_mansion_hall.json: after the four wave-1 Dusks die, the host is downed through the DownedSpike fixture channel's Kill (KH2COOP_DOWNED_SPIKE_FIXTURE=1, a test channel product play never maps; the downing itself is the product's logical downing). Wave 2 must still appear and die on both seats while the other seat fights alone; the downed seat is revived or returned; both load Axel I's room. Rehearsal save. No save.

steps.message: the rehearsal save must load Twilight Town on both seats

steps.expr: log_count('[prologue] unpinned start', 0) > 0 and log_count('[prologue] unpinned start', 1) > 0
log_count('control released at=02/13 evt=134 site=tt19-134', 0) > 0 and log_count('control released at=02/13 evt=134 site=tt19-134', 1) > 0
all(len([a for a in actors(i) if a['name']=='P_EX110']) == 2 for i in (0, 1))
steps.message: both seats must hold both Roxases at tt19-134
wave 1 must finish before the downing

steps.expr: {'hostDeaths': log_count('[enemysync] host death epoch', 0) - saved['deaths_before'], 'deathWithoutBinding': log_count('death-without-continuous-binding', 1), 'unmatched': [m['u'] for m in log_matches(r'\[statehash\] role=client .* unmatched=(?P<u>\d+)', 1)][-1:], 'downed': [m['l'] for m in log_matches(r'(?P<l>\[downed\] (?:gate intercept|logical hold ended|revive returned|return|owed return).*)', 0)][-6:], 'fullPartyDown': log_count('[downed] full party down', 0)}

steps.message: wave 2 must appear and die on both seats while the host is down

steps.expr: [log_count('[mission-mirror] host end trap=', 0), log_count('client end like the host', 1) + log_count('client fail like the host', 1)]

steps.message: one host mission end, followed at most once, and never a full-party down
